config.selectionRule: A* preferred action first; sweep safe alternatives; bounded temporary score regression is allowed only inside tentative bridges; commit only after score exceeds last committed score

interpretation: The full measured MaleCNS and V5 sensory/core policy remain frozen and active. Only the existing small motor readout output layers are minimally repaired. Terminal failures and long no-progress tails are both treated as repair frontiers. At each frontier the A* first action is preferred, but if that action is incompatible with the current closed-loop readout the script also evaluates every other immediately safe local action. For stalls, the earliest teacher disagreement in the current no-progress tail is repaired so the repeated blocked/waiting suffix is not protected. The update direction is projected into the exact nullspace of every earlier on-policy readout feature. Score-neutral or slightly score-negative tactical moves may be used only inside a bounded tentative bridge. This allows necessary backward/detour maneuvers without permanently accepting regression. The complete bridge commits only after a later repair exceeds the last committed score; otherwise every tentative repair is rolled back. Final success additionally requires a bounded no-progress streak and blocked-action rate.
